pr_title: shared/machine-image: avoid passing NULL to log_debug_errno

issue_context.title: log.h:220:27: error: ‘%s’ directive argument is null [-Werror=format-overflow=]
issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
> 242 with cherry picked commit c98b354500

<!-- **NOTE:** Do not submit bug reports about anything but the two most recently released systemd versions upstream! -->
<!-- For older version please use distribution trackers (see https://github.com/systemd/systemd/blob/master/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#filing-issues). -->

**Used distribution**
 > Gentoo

**Expected behaviour you didn't see**
 > Able to build systemd :)

**Unexpected behaviour you saw**
 > Build failure. There are multiple warnings that are treated as errors. Here's one:
```
[449/1217] x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-gcc -m32 -Isrc/shared/5afaae1@@systemd-shared-242@sta -Isrc/shared -I../systemd-242/src/shared -Isrc/basic -I../systemd-242/src/basic -Isrc/systemd -I../systemd-242/src/systemd -Isrc/journal -I../systemd-24>
FAILED: src/shared/5afaae1@@systemd-shared-242@sta/machine-image.c.o
x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-gcc -m32 -Isrc/shared/5afaae1@@systemd-shared-242@sta -Isrc/shared -I../systemd-242/src/shared -Isrc/basic -I../systemd-242/src/basic -Isrc/systemd -I../systemd-242/src/systemd -Isrc/journal -I../systemd-242/src/journ>
In file included from ../systemd-242/src/basic/macro.h:549,
                 from ../systemd-242/src/basic/alloc-util.h:9,
                 from ../systemd-242/src/shared/machine-image.c:15:
In function ‘image_make’,
    inlined from ‘image_from_path’ at ../systemd-242/src/shared/machine-image.c:496:16:
../systemd-242/src/basic/log.h:220:27: error: ‘%s’ directive argument is null [-Werror=format-overflow=]
  220 |                         ? log_internal_realm(LOG_REALM_PLUS_LEVEL(_realm, _level), _e, \
      |                           ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  221 |                                              __FILE__, __LINE__, __func__, __VA_ARGS__) \
      |                                              ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
../systemd-242/src/basic/log.h:226:9: note: in expansion of macro ‘log_full_errno_realm’
  226 |         log_full_errno_realm(LOG_REALM, (level), (error), __VA_ARGS__)
      |         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
../systemd-242/src/basic/log.h:241:41: note: in expansion of macro ‘log_full_errno’
  241 | #define log_debug_errno(error, ...)     log_full_errno(LOG_DEBUG,   error, __VA_ARGS__)
      |                                         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~
../systemd-242/src/shared/machine-image.c:376:41: note: in expansion of macro ‘log_debug_errno’
  376 |                                         log_debug_errno(errno, "Failed to issue BLKROGET on device %s/%s, ignoring: %m", path, filename);
      |                                         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
../systemd-242/src/shared/machine-image.c: In function ‘image_from_path’:
../systemd-242/src/shared/machine-image.c:376:100: note: format string is defined here
  376 |                                         log_debug_errno(errno, "Failed to issue BLKROGET on device %s/%s, ignoring: %m", path, filename);
      |                                                                                                    ^~
In file included from ../systemd-242/src/basic/macro.h:549,
                 from ../systemd-242/src/basic/alloc-util.h:9,
                 from ../systemd-242/src/shared/machine-image.c:15:
In function ‘image_make’,
    inlined from ‘image_from_path’ at ../systemd-242/src/shared/machine-image.c:496:16:
../systemd-242/src/basic/log.h:220:27: error: ‘%s’ directive argument is null [-Werror=format-overflow=]
  220 |                         ? log_internal_realm(LOG_REALM_PLUS_LEVEL(_realm, _level), _e, \
      |                           ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  221 |                                              __FILE__, __LINE__, __func__, __VA_ARGS__) \
      |                                              ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```
Full build log: https://bugs.gentoo.org/attachment.cgi?id=575660

**Steps to reproduce the problem**

> $ gcc --version
> gcc (Gentoo 9.1.0 p1.0) 9.1.0

This issue looks similar to https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/11369 and https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/12373 https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/12454 however, I have cherry picked c98b354500 and am on systemd 242, so based on the resolved status of those issues, I'm either experiencing a different problem or the resolution to those issues was incomplete.

The `-O3` CFLAG is the key to reproducing this issue. The problem does not occur with `-O2`.
comments:
I guess you may need to cherry-pick the rest of the fixes from https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/12501.

```
$ gcc --version
gcc (GCC) 9.1.1 20190503 (Red Hat 9.1.1-1)
$ git describe
v242-rc4-449-gdeb2cfa4c6
$ meson build -Dc_args="-O3"
...
$ ninja -C build
ninja: Entering directory `build'
[332/1802] Compiling C object 'src/shared/5afaae1@@systemd-shared-242@sta/install.c.o'.
In function ‘install_info_add’,

../src/shared/install.c:1045:24: warning: argument 1 null where non-null expected [-Wnonnull]
 1045 |                 name = basename(path);
      |                        ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~

      |              ^~~~~~~~
[409/1802] Compiling C object 'src/core/2ac6ece@@core@sta/manager.c.o'.
In function ‘manager_load_unit_prepare’,
    inlined from ‘manager_load_unit’ at ../src/core/manager.c:2024:13,
    inlined from ‘manager_add_job_by_name’ at ../src/core/manager.c:1807:13:
../src/core/manager.c:1968:24: warning: argument 1 null where non-null expected [-Wnonnull]
 1968 |                 name = basename(path);
      |                        ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~
In file included from ../src/core/manager.c:7:
../src/core/manager.c: In function ‘manager_add_job_by_name’:
/usr/include/string.h:486:14: note: in a call to function ‘basename’ declared here
  486 | extern char *basename (const char *__filename) __THROW __nonnull ((1));

[1802/1802] Generating systemd.index.7 with a custom command.
```

I confirm that using all 5 of the commits in https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/12501 fixes this issue. Thanks!

review_comments: This creates an unnecessary allocation in most cases. But it's a not a hot path, so we don't need to optimize.
